author: mako maintainers
tooling: hand-written from the [advisories] ignore list in deny.toml; `cargo xtask check-vex` holds the two equal

statements.impact_statement: Informational advisory (unmaintained), no vulnerability. bincode 1.x is pulled by slatedb through foyer and serialises SlateDB's own cache structures, never input from outside the process.
Informational advisory (unmaintained), no vulnerability. paste is a proc-macro reached through slatedb, datafusion and typst's hayagriva; it runs at compile time and contributes no code to a binary.
Informational advisory (unmaintained), no vulnerability. ttf-parser is Typst's font reader in outputd; the fonts it reads are the bundled typst-assets set, and no template or request can supply one.

Quadratic duplicate-attribute scan, patched in 0.41. Every parser that reads XML from a counterparty is on quick-xml 0.41 (mako's own crates, asx-rs for AS4). 0.39.4 is reached only through opendal, which parses authenticated S3/GCS/Azure responses for edmd's cold tier; 0.38.4 only through typst's hayagriva/citationberg, which parses bundled assets while rendering mako's own templates.
Unbounded namespace-declaration allocation in NsReader, patched in 0.41. Same versions and same reachability as RUSTSEC-2026-0194: no counterparty-controlled XML reaches 0.38.4 or 0.39.4.
tokio-tar is a dev-dependency only, through testcontainers, and is linked into no release binary.

Informational advisory (unmaintained), no vulnerability. yaml-rust loads syntect's syntax definitions inside typst-library in outputd; an invoice template contains no code block, and the definitions are bundled.
Informational advisory (unmaintained), no vulnerability. rustybuzz is Typst's text shaper on outputd's render path, fed only the bundled fonts, mako's own invoice model and the operator's template.
Informational advisory (unmaintained), no vulnerability. rustls-pemfile is a dev-dependency only, through testcontainers and bollard, and is linked into no release binary.

The Marvin timing side channel leaks a private key through private-key operations. rsa is reached through jsonwebtoken in mako-service, which verifies RS256/RS384/RS512 OIDC tokens against the identity provider's public JWKS; no release binary holds an RSA private key or decrypts or signs with one. AS4 cryptography runs on OpenSSL through asx-rs, not on this crate.
